source.title: teamLab Borderless: MORI Building DIGITAL ART MUSEUM
source.creator: teamLab

rationale: Treats artworks as mobile spatial entities that cross room boundaries rather than fixed exhibits; the guide app is location-relative and some works allow visitor participation.
notes: The official museum page states that there are no fixed artwork captions because artworks move across spaces; the app identifies the concept of the work nearest the visitor and can participate in Infinite Crystal World.

decision.rationale: Adds a spatial-information-architecture reference where content is not owned by one container or room, and context follows the viewer's current location.
